instagram.caption:
ADHD mom diary: my toddler napped for 2 hours and I didn't start anything. It's called waiting mode.

It's not laziness. Part of my brain stays on alert for the next interruption, so I can't start.

1. 1:00, nap starts, proposal due tomorrow
2. I sit down to start... and wait
3. 2:40, still nothing, now I'm mad at myself too
4. I said the task out loud and did only step 1: open the doc

2:58, first page done. She woke up at 3:05.

Save this for the next nap, and send it to the mom friend who gets it.

💜 The app I use is FOCO, link in bio.
instagram.altText: Diary-style carousel on cream paper with taped photos of a mom working from home during her toddler's nap, about ADHD waiting mode and starting a work task with one tiny step in FOCO.

blocks.text: my toddler napped for 2 hours and i didn't start *anything.*
1:00. nap starts. the client proposal is due tomorrow.
i sat down to start. *and waited.*
for her to wake up. for the school to call. for the next thing.
a mom on reddit put it perfectly:
"always on alert in case the kid needs something. so no doing of anything."
and now i'm mad at myself for being in waiting mode.
so i opened FOCO and just said it out loud.
not the whole proposal. just that.
she woke up at 3:05. for once, i'd started.
